## What's here today

DuckDB's [R client](https://duckdb.org/docs/api/r) (`install.packages("duckdb")`)
speaks the same SQL every other client on this site uses — the `ATTACH`
statement on the [Start here](index.qmd) page and the query patterns on the
[Python](python.qmd) page carry over directly: open a
`duckdb::duckdb()` connection, `dbExecute()` the `INSTALL`/`LOAD`/`ATTACH`
statements once, then `dbGetQuery()` any SQL from this site.
